summary: Migration credit applied to legacy subaccount due to ledger ID collision after reserved-capacity migration
description:
Issue summary:
BrightCart Labs was promised a one-time migration credit (Sales ticket #SAL-78910) to offset costs for migrating reserved capacity from a pilot org to their production org. The credit appears on our ledger, but it was applied to a stale legacy subaccount (legacy_sub_42) that BrightCart thought had been deprovisioned during the migration. Result: customer invoice for March shows no migration credit and a larger-than-expected charge; a different, inactive subaccount has a negative line item referencing the migration credit.

Impact:
- Customer-facing: BrightCart is disputing the March invoice and has paused autopay pending a corrected invoice. This blocks revenue recognition for the cycle and is causing an urgent finance escalation.
- Technical: Credits were posted, but attribution on ledger records appears incorrect (applied to deprecated subaccount id). No evidence yet of duplicate credit consumption, but accounting mismatch exists.

Environment:
- Redwood production billing/ledger service
- Reserved capacity migration performed on 2026-03-05 (internal migration job MIG-2026-0305)
- Customer region: us-east-1
- Customer tier: Dedicated (reserved GPUs)

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Sales created migration credit SAL-78910 on 2026-03-04 for customer org brightcart-prod (org_id: OC-9087).
2) Engineering ran migration job MIG-2026-0305 which created transient legacy_sub_42 and then attempted to deprovision it.
3) Billing run on 2026-03-07 posted credits to ledger with ledger_id L-45582.
4) Payment and invoice generation on 2026-03-08 attributed the credit to legacy_sub_42 (id: SUB-00042) instead of brightcart-prod (SUB-9087).
5) Customer received invoice INV-BC-202603 showing full charge; separate ledger export shows negative line for SUB-00042.

Expected behavior:
- The migration credit SAL-78910 should be allocated to brightcart-prod (SUB-9087) and reflected on the customer's March invoice, reducing their charge and allowing autopay to proceed.

Actual behavior:
- Credit was applied to a decommissioned legacy subaccount (SUB-00042), leaving the customer's invoice unchanged and creating a negative line on an orphaned subaccount.

Attachments / logs / references:
- Sales ticket: SAL-78910 (request & approval email chain)
- Migration job: MIG-2026-0305 (internal runbook link)
- Ledger export: ledger_export_2026-03-07.csv (attached by customer)
- Invoice: INV-BC-202603 (PDF attached by customer)

Business ask / Desired outcome:
1) Immediate: Reallocate the recorded credit to brightcart-prod (SUB-9087) and reissue corrected invoice so customer can re-enable autopay.
2) Short-term: Add manual check in billing pipeline to prevent credits being posted to subaccounts marked deprovisioned within last 14 days.
3) Follow-up: Root cause analysis and a postmortem with corrective action to prevent ledger attribution collisions during migration flows.

Urgency: High — customer has paused autopay and finance is blocking revenue recognition.
comments: 2026-03-14 09:12 - Maya Patel: Customer reported invoice doesn't include agreed migration credit; provided SAL-78910 and INV-BC-202603. Asking for urgent reissue.
2026-03-14 10:01 - Billing Triage (Diego Ramirez): Assigned for initial triage. Requesting ledger export and migration run logs from infra. Adding components billing/ledger-service/metering.

2026-03-14 11:08 - Finance (Elena Kostova): Provided account-level ledger extract and highlighted negative line on SUB-00042. Suspect subaccount id collision during migration. Marking as finance-critical.

2026-03-14 11:45 - Infra (Jin Park): Confirmed migration job created transient subaccount SUB-00042 and there was a delayed deprovision call that returned 204 but did not remove id from some mapping table. Investigating mapping cleanup race.

2026-03-14 12:30 - Support (Diego Ramirez): Requested patch to billing reconciler to detect credits posted to subaccounts with last_active < deprovision_time + 24h. Temporary workaround: will hold reissue until confirm credit available for reallocation.

2026-03-14 13:15 - Customer (BrightCart billing contact, L. Nguyen): Customer confirmed they decommissioned the pilot org and urgently need corrected invoice to unblock autopay. Asked for ETA within 24 hours.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: ledger-service matches credit line to subaccount by the first matching subaccount id returned by migration hooks. If a transient subaccount was recently created/deprovisioned due to migration steps, a stale mapping entry (legacy_sub_42) was still present in the account-to-subaccount resolver and received the credit. Evidence: ledger_export_2026-03-07.csv shows credit posted with org_id referencing OC-9087 but subaccount_id resolved as SUB-00042. Migration run logs show deprovision delayed for ~2 minutes, and a cleanup job (CLEAN-evict) reaped mapping after billing run. Possible root cause: race between billing posting job (fast path) and deprovision cleanup (async).
resolution_notes: TBD - awaiting confirmation from billing reallocation job. Finance has been alerted and will hold collections until corrected invoice is issued.
